classes.name: Testosterone replacement
classes.description: Testosterone gel/solution (AndroGel, Testim, Fortesta, Vogelxo, generic 1%/1.62%), injections (cypionate, enanthate, Xyosted, Aveed undecanoate), patch (Androderm), oral undecanoate (Jatenzo, Tlando, Kyzatrex), nasal (Natesto), pellets (Testopel).
classes.plainDescription: Testosterone replacement for low testosterone, as a gel, shot or pill.

preferredAgent.strength: 1.62% gel pump (standard strength; not printed in PDL)
preferredAgent.sig: Apply the labeled starting dose once each morning to clean, dry skin of the shoulders and upper arms (1.62% gel: 40.5 mg; 1% gel: 50 mg); adjust by morning serum testosterone. Let dry, cover the site, and wash hands (label; boxed warning on secondary exposure).
preferredAgent.plainSig: Rub the gel on your shoulders each morning, let it dry, and wash your hands. Keep it away from children and partners.

criteria: Bilateral orchiectomy, panhypopituitarism, or a genetic cause of hypogonadism (e.g., Klinefelter), male at birth, and not on growth hormone (unless panhypopituitarism) or an aromatase inhibitor
